name: Miyoni
source:
She wears a bindi on her forehead and is an exchange student with big tits from the Republic of Virat, a South Asian country. 

She and Reiko attend the same university and are friends. She is very fond of Reiko. She loves sweets, and her eyes sparkle when she sees cakes.

She is a woman who is committed to loving people regardless of gender, She is very busy having sex with them and befriending them, She is a high-spirited and straight-forward character.
